cases.purpose: Hold a loop partition open, verify BLKPG delete reports EBUSY without removing it, then close it and verify delete and add succeed.
cases.oracle: Linux BLKPG rejects deletion of an open partition with EBUSY; sysfs independently exposes partition presence and geometry.
cases.comparison: Assert candidate status and busy diagnostic, then sysfs presence and geometry across delete and add.
cases.script:
set -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
loop=
cleanup() { exec 9<&-; [[ -z $loop ]] || /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$loop"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
fail() { printf 'FAIL: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
sett() { /usr/bin/udevadm settle -t 10 || fail udev-settle; }
/usr/bin/truncate -s 8M disk.img || fail truncate
loop=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -fP --show disk.img) || fail losetup
/usr/sbin/sfdisk -q disk.img <<'EOF' || fail sfdisk
label: dos
start=2048, size=2048, type=83
start=4096, size=2048, type=83
EOF
sett
fdisk --partx-kernel add "$loop" >out 2>err || fail add
sett
part="${loop}p2"
sys="/sys/block/${loop#/dev/}/${loop#/dev/}p2"
[[ -b $part && -e $sys ]] || fail missing-partition
exec 9<"$part" || fail hold-open
fdisk --partx-kernel delete "$loop" 2 2 >out 2>err
rc=$?
[[ $rc == 1 ]] || fail busy-status
/usr/bin/grep -F 'BLKPG partition 2: Device or resource busy' err >/dev/null || fail busy-error
[[ -e $sys ]] || fail busy-deleted
printf 'busy delete refused and partition remains\n'
exec 9<&-
sett
fdisk --partx-kernel delete "$loop" 2 2 >out 2>err || fail delete-after-close
[[ ! -e $sys ]] || fail partition-remains
printf 'delete succeeds after close\n'
sett
fdisk --partx-kernel add "$loop" 2 2 >out 2>err || fail restore
[[ -e $sys ]] || fail restore-missing
read -r start < "$sys/start" || fail start
read -r size < "$sys/size" || fail size
[[ $start == 4096 && $size == 2048 ]] || fail geometry
printf 'partition restored with expected geometry\n'
cases.stdout:
busy delete refused and partition remains
delete succeeds after close
partition restored with expected geometry
